title: Electronics Cap When a Duplicate Payment Is Re-Settled (Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan)
content:
**Rule.** When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim carrying a duplicate payment is re-settled, the electronics value is capped at the duplicate re-settlement's electronics cap: the level's electronics sublimit multiplied by 1.5 when the covered unit's class includes an individual door alarm, by 1.25 when the class has no door alarm and no drive-up access, and by 1 otherwise. The features are those of the unit class of the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

| Door alarm | Drive-up access | Multiplier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes or no | 1.5 |
| no | no | 1.25 |
| no | yes | 1 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An electronics sublimit of 3,500.00 becomes 5,250.00 in a door-alarm class and 4,375.00 in an interior class without an alarm.
